not_added_flag.item: 4 JFR Mac photos with ambiguous or unmatched vitola names
not_added_flag.issue:
1) 'JFR_20-St_01.jpg' - no vitola abbreviating to 'St' (Stout/Short/Salomon, etc.) was found anywhere in the confirmed 4-size JFR 20th Anniversary lineup (Gordito/770/Titan/Toro). Possibly a 5th SKU not yet covered in press, or an unrelated product. NOT published as a confirmed vitola.

2) 'JFR_Luna-Hab-Rob_01.jpg' and 'JFR_Luna-Hab-Short_01.jpg' - both 'Short Robusto' (4.25x52) and 'Short Titan' (4.25-4.75x60) exist for JFR Lunatic Habano; 'Rob' and 'Short' alone don't disambiguate with certainty which file is which.

3) 'JFR_Luna-Mad-El_01.jpg' - ambiguous between 'El Chiquito' (4.7x70) and 'El Grande' (5.5x80), both real JFR Lunatic Maduro vitolas starting with 'El.'

4) 'JFR_Luna-Mad-Short_01.jpg' - same Short Robusto vs. Short Titan ambiguity as (2), for the Maduro line.
